about_the_game:
A First-Person Puzzle Game about Remnants of Once great Civilization

In a dystopian future,  abandoned prisons patrolled by robots clinging to forgotten orders. Some obey. Some resist.

You are a prisoner 811, armed only with a stolen control device and your wits.

Explore brutalist complex of Pocket prisons and navigate treacherous environments.

Solve intricate puzzles, manipulate robots, and bend the laws of space to outsmart enemies

Features:

  • Think Like a Prisoner: Hack, trick, and outmaneuver robots using their own protocols.

  • A World of Hidden Rules:  Witness a future where remnants of humanity scrape for power even after the end of the world

  • Atmospheric Storytelling: Piece together the prison’s history through eerie logs and environmental clues.

Freedom is a puzzle. Solve it.

name: Pocket Dictator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 (version 2004 or newer)
  • Processor: 4 core CPU @ 2.5 GHz (AMD Ryzen 5, Intel core i3/i5)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 470, GeForce GTX 970, Intel Arc A580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 (version 2004 or newer)
  • Processor: 6 or 8 core CPU @ 3.0 GHz (AMD Ryzen 7, Intel core i5/i7)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8+ GB VRAM; Radeon RX 6800, GeForce RTX 3070, Intel Arc B580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Pocket Dictator is a first-person puzzle game set in a distant future. An abandoned prison is inhabited by many robots. Friendly and not so much
